note_md5: scaffolds.py changed after the API pilot only by appending the Molmo2 644-px export helpers (molmo_input/export_molmo; the Molmo2 pilot already used the frozen file); re-rendering the 18 synthetic pilot inputs reproduces them byte-for-byte: True; prompt texts unchanged.
design_decided_on: 3 synthetic images (cnn/synth.py v2: syn1 plain 52x46, syn2 twill21 82x64, syn3 plain 108x90) + common sense; no legacy label was looked at.

design_choices.S1: margin rulers (top/left), tick every 0.1 inch extending 18 px into the fabric as two-tone marks; crop 1440 px
design_choices.S1t: text-only control: S1 instruction without ruler, image byte-identical to the P1 input
design_choices.S2: two-tone (black core, white edge) guide lines through the centre, ticks every 0.1 inch, segments labelled H1..H10 / V1..V10 (plain 1..10 labels collided near the crossing on the synthetic preview)
design_choices.S3: four 0.1x0.1-inch insets centred at the quadrant centres, INTER_CUBIC to 727 px tiles, 2x2 with labels
design_choices.S4: band 0.05 inch, detrend/normalise over 0.1 inch, Gaussian sigma = S/1500; oracle prominence 0.5 (band widths 0.03-0.2 and prominences 0.2-1.5 checked on synthetic: 0.05/0.5 exact on the vertical-yarn axis for all 3; the horizontal-yarn profile of syn1 shows a 2x harmonic at every setting -> reported, not tuned away)

primary_rationale: lowest mean synthetic-pilot MAPE over the API models (7.3 %) and over all 4 models; the only scaffold that clearly beat P1 for the two weak API models on synthetic. Confirmatory test per model: S3 vs own P1 on legacy-13 (axis-matched, Wilcoxon on per-count abs % error, Holm over 4 models); everything else exploratory.

models.reasoning: min (as P1: GPT minimal, Flash minimal, Qwen off)

legacy_plan: r0: 5 conditions x 20 legacy images (13 labelled + 7 unlabelled) x 3 API models + Molmo2; r1: same for the 3 API models (stability, mean-of-2); Qwen3.8-27B P1 r1/r2 (its P1 had no repeats). Budget sub-cap US$8, stop at 7.5.
gemini_max_tokens_note: kept at 3000 (= its P2 budget); max on the synthetic pilot 2982, no truncation; Gemini 3.x thinking grows with max_tokens so raising it would change behaviour vs P1/P2.

post_freeze_additions.when: after legacy r0/r1 were run and scored
